title: Hopping
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Hop on soft ground. Chalk the four floor patterns. Let the children rest the hopping leg often.

skills.key_step: The child says a hop takes off and lands on the same foot, and names its directions and floor patterns.

floor.question: How many feet do you land on in a jump?

steps: Take off and land on the same foot.
Follow the line on the ground.

board.do: Watch my feet: am I hopping or jumping?
Which foot will I land on?

misconceptions.ask: Wanjiru takes off on two feet and lands on two feet. Is that a hop?
misconceptions.repair: Lift one foot and hop, then jump on two feet, and compare.

misconceptions.ask: In a hop, which foot do you land on?
misconceptions.repair: Hold a bean bag on the hopping knee and keep that foot.

misconceptions.ask: Hop to your right. Which side do you go to?
misconceptions.repair: Tie a ribbon on the right wrist and hop that way.

misconceptions.ask: A line bends like a river with no corners. Is it a zigzag?
misconceptions.repair: Chalk a zigzag with sharp corners beside a curve.

checks.question: How many feet do you hop on?
Name a floor pattern for hopping.
checks.answer: any of: straight, curved, circular, zigzag
